title: Stability Analysis of Signed Graphs under Structural Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2610.30444v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Signed graph learning has emerged as a powerful framework for modeling networks with both positive and negative interactions. While graph-filter-based methods have achieved promising empirical performance on signed networks, their stability under edge perturbations remains less well understood. Existing stability analyses primarily focus on unsigned graphs and do not account for sign-flip perturbations. In this paper, we study the stability of signed graph filters under edge additions, deletions, and sign flips. Our theoretical analysis reveals how signed edge perturbations and node feature correlations jointly determine the learned representation stability. Based on this analysis, we propose a theory-guided perturbation strategy that selects structurally influential signed-edge modifications. translated_title: 结构扰动下符号图的稳定性分析
translated_abstract: 符号图学习已成为建模同时包含正负交互关系的网络的强大框架。尽管基于图滤波器的方法在符号网络上取得了令人满意的实证性能，但其在边扰动下的稳定性仍缺乏充分的理解。现有的稳定性分析主要针对无符号图，并未考虑符号翻转扰动。本文研究了符号图滤波器在边添加、边删除和符号翻转下的稳定性。我们的理论分析揭示了符号边扰动与节点特征相关性如何共同决定学习表示的稳定性。基于这一分析，我们提出了一种理论引导的扰动策略，用于选择具有结构性影响力的符号边修改操作。在合成和真实符号图上的实验表明，所提出的方法能够持续引发更大的嵌入漂移和极性变化（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了符号图滤波器在边添加、删除和符号翻转等结构扰动下的稳定性，揭示了符号边扰动与节点特征相关性对学习表示稳定性的联合决定作用，并据此提出了一种理论引导的扰动策略来选择结构性影响显著的符号边修改。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic stability analysis of signed graph filters under edge additions, deletions, and sign flips, revealing how signed perturbations and node feature correlations jointly determine representation stability, and proposes a theory-guided perturbation strategy for selecting structurally influential signed-edge modifications.
